Weather Presenter

Weather Presenter

⭐ 0

Rules

1 · Read the forecast / 2 · Listen

  1. Read or listen to the weather forecast.
  2. Tap a weather symbol, then tap the box of the region. Write the temperature under it (for example -2 or 18).
  3. Press Check: every right symbol and every right temperature = ⭐.

3 · Write the forecast

  1. Look at the map and write a weather forecast for all five regions.
  2. For every region write the weather and the temperature, for example: In Scotland it will be snowy and cold, with minus 2 degrees.
  3. Press Check: ⭐ for every region with the right weather and temperature.

4 · Present

  1. You are the weather presenter! Look at the map and present the weather in about one minute.
  2. Use the phrases on the right. You can record yourself and listen to your forecast.
